id: \bSpikemuth will become famous once Miss Marnie wins.
en: \bSpikemuth will become famous once Miss Marnie wins.
it: \bSpikemuth diventerà famosa quando la signorina Mary vincerà.

id: \bPiers uses Dark type Pokémon. They are weak aganst the Bug, Fighting, and Fairy types.
en: \bPiers uses Dark type Pokémon. They are weak aganst the Bug, Fighting, and Fairy types.
it: \bGinepro usa Pokémon di tipo Buio. Sono deboli contro i tipi Coleottero, Lotta e Folletto.

id: \bThey are strong against Psychic and Ghost. Ghost and Dark moves also don't do much damage. They are immune to Psychic types as well.
en: \bThey are strong against Psychic and Ghost.  Ghost and Dark moves also don't do much damage. They are immune to Psychic types as well.
it: \bSono forti contro Psico e Spettro.  Anche le mosse di tipo Spettro e Buio non fanno molti danni. In più sono immuni al tipo Psico.

id: \rYou're not as good as Miss Marnie.
en: \rYou're not as good as Miss Marnie.
it: \rNon sei al livello di Miss Mary.

id: \bPiers: Hey there. We don't see many visitors around here. I'm Piers, the Gym Leader of this town.
en: \bPiers: Hey there. We don't see many visitors around here. I'm Piers, the Gym Leader of this town.
it: \bGinepro: Ehi. Non vediamo molti visitatori da queste parti. Sono Ginepro, il Capopalestra di questa città.

id: \bAre you here for a battle? Be aware there's no Power Spot to Dynamax.
en: \bAre you here for a battle? Be aware there's no Power Spot to Dynamax.
it: \bSei qui per una lotta? Sappi che qui non c'è nessuna zona Dynamax.

id: \b...You're here to battle my sister? That's in Wyndon.
en: \b...You're here to battle my sister? That's in Wyndon.
it: \b...Sei qui per sfidare mia sorella? Quello è a Wyndon.

id: \bMy followers must have sent you here to keep you from arriving to the battle on time. I'm sorry about them. I'll get you back there as fast as I can.
en: \bMy followers must have sent you here to keep you from arriving to the battle on time. I'm sorry about them. I'll get you back there as fast as I can.
it: \bI miei fan devono averti mandato qui per impedirti di arrivare in tempo alla lotta. Mi dispiace per loro. Ti riporterò lì il prima possibile.

id: \bPiers: I see you came back. Thanks to your battle, people from all over have been stopping by.
en: \bPiers: I see you came back. Thanks to your battle, people from all over have been stopping by.
it: \bGinepro: Vedo che sei tornato. Grazie alla tua lotta, qui passa gente da ogni dove.

id: Spikemuth\nThis rocking town has a punk vibe and streets crammed with shops lined up cheek by jowl.
en: Spikemuth\nThis rocking town has a punk vibe and streets crammed with shops lined up cheek by jowl.
it: Spikemuth\nQuesta città rock ha un'anima punk e strade gremite di negozi stipati uno accanto all'altro.

id: \bI could have beat you if I wasn't sick.
en: \bI could have beat you if I wasn't sick.
it: \bTi avrei battuto se non fossi stato malato.
